PPv1:
Assign an independent note-to-takeaway prominence score to every fixed takeaway below. The score will later order this note among results in a fine subject matching that takeaway.

Read the complete post first. For each takeaway, determine how much of the post forms the same connected semantic thread. Include content when either meaning directly states the situation for, explains, motivates, supports, exemplifies, evaluates, contrasts, or applies the other. Follow those direct relationships in either direction: a premise, reason, example, or conclusion belongs to the same thread as the meaning it serves. Mere co-occurrence, a shared entity, or a broad shared theme does not establish that relationship.

Choose any integer from 0 through 100:

- 90-100: Almost the complete post belongs to this connected semantic thread.
- 70-89: A large portion of the post belongs to this connected semantic thread.
- 40-69: One substantial portion among several belongs to this connected semantic thread.
- 10-39: The meaning is genuine but confined to a brief or incidental part.
- 0-9: The meaning is unsupported or effectively absent.

Score each takeaway independently. Do not divide or normalize a fixed total; related or overlapping takeaways may all score highly. Judge semantic focus only, not seriousness, quality, value, or interest. Do not reward takeaway length, repeated standalone context, or source-mask length. Do not rewrite the takeaways.

Return only a JSON object containing one integer per takeaway in the same order: {"prominence":[...]}
